scope: Shared production GTK display renderer; synthetic xRGB framebuffer. Frame-clock spans include the Update phase and end at after-paint; they exclude compositor presentation/GPU completion. Total process CPU includes synthetic pixel generation; its main-thread CPU is also recorded per update. No SPICE decoding, guest workload or libvirt is measured.
baseline_qa_note: Saved baseline executable predates exhaustive sparse/full image comparison and actual-scale assertions. Its correctness flag covers its original checks. Workload generation and measured clock/CPU phases are unchanged; all 36 current trials include exhaustive output comparison after timing.
